experiments.purpose: Prospective check that oldest-drive contribution changes with waiting time; compare to the newest-drive condition at the same u and h.
Matched temporal-position contrast with the preceding condition.
Check the oldest-drive contribution at longer waiting time.
Matched temporal-position contrast at longer waiting time.

prospective_contrast: The fit-only model will compare the oldest- and newest-drive coefficients and their interactions with h. The proposed four-condition follow-up repeats those matched temporal-position contrasts at two waiting times. It can refute a position-dependent, waiting-time-modulated history effect if the matched contrasts are equal within the calibrated 0.015 response error, or if the model misses the later independent targets beyond RMSE 0.06.
refutation_condition: Refute the endpoint-only representation if matched conditions sharing u, h, history[0], and history[3] but differing in history[1] or history[2] produce a response difference exceeding 0.030 (twice the certified absolute error bound). Refute the fitted model if independent raw-response RMSE exceeds 0.06.
scientific_change: Replace the insufficient assumption o=f(u,h) with a testable endpoint-history response: response may depend on the oldest and newest prior drives, with quadratic interactions allowing their effects to vary with current drive and waiting time. The observed ordered-history contrasts establish temporal-position sensitivity; intermediate history levels have not been shown negligible, so endpoint sufficiency remains a provisional, refutable restriction.
